newsitem.title: CHILE: Santander-Chile Q1 net 6.5 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Santander-Chile Q1 net 6.5 bln pesos.

text.p: Banco Santander-Chile reported first quarter profits at 6.53 billion pesos, the Banking Superintendency reported.
No comparative figures were possible because the bank was formed in mid-1996 with the merger of Banco Santander and Banco Osorno y La Union.
Its first-quarter outstanding loans stood at 2.4 trillion pesos, capital and reservers were 284 billion pesos, and annualized return on capital and reserves was 9.2 percent, said the superintendency.
